dateline: BTS opened the ARIRANG World Tour's four-show Los Angeles run at SoFi Stadium (Sept 1, 2, 5, 6) as the city declared Sept 1-8 'BTS Week' and lit City Hall red in the group's honor (Sept 1) — the group's first LA visit in nearly five years. The Sept 1 setlist included live tour debuts of 'they don't know 'bout us,' 'Merry Go Round,' 'Please,' and 'Into the Sun.' Album 'ARIRANG' logged its 23rd consecutive week on the Billboard 200 (No. 31, chart dated Sept 5) as BTS played the run's second night (Sept 2).
heroHeadline: Day 4,829: Los Angeles Declares 'BTS Week' as BTS Opens Four-Show SoFi Stadium Run
heroSubtitle: September 2, 2026 is Day 4,829 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass proclaimed Sept 1-8 'BTS Week' and lit City Hall red (Sept 1) as BTS opened its four sold-out ARIRANG World Tour shows at SoFi Stadium (Sept 1, 2, 5, 6) — the North American leg's final stop and the group's first LA visit since December 2021. Opening night's setlist featured live tour debuts of 'they don't know 'bout us,' 'Merry Go Round,' 'Please,' and 'Into the Sun.' As the run's second show played (Sept 2), 'ARIRANG' extended its Billboard 200 stay to a 23rd consecutive week (No. 31, chart dated Sept 5), with lead single 'Swim' holding No. 4 on the Global Excl. US chart.
